jobs.title: Data Labeling Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Bobyard

Bobyard is building the AI that brings visual intelligence to construction. We're a Series A startup backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and our models are trained on millions of construction drawings to help contractors estimate and bid faster. We're small, moving fast, and the work we ship directly changes whether a contractor wins or loses a bid.

About the role

Our models are only as good as the data behind them. You'll own the labeling operation end to end — the annotator team, the quality bar, the datasets themselves. This is a first-in-function hire: there's no playbook waiting for you, you'll build it. Success looks like a labeling operation that's fast, accurate, and trusted enough that ML engineers stop double-checking your team's work.

What you'll do

 - Build and run the annotator team — recruit, onboard, train, and hold the bar on quality and throughput

 - Own labeling quality — review annotations, catch systematic errors before they hit a model, and turn what you find into sharper guidelines

 - Clean up the datasets we already have — fix inconsistent labels, missing metadata, duplicates, and other issues quietly hurting model performance

 - Source new data — find and organize construction drawings that expand our coverage of formats, classes, and edge cases we're currently missing

 - Turn ML requests into shipped datasets — scope the ask, run the project, deliver clean data on time

 - Work directly with ML engineers to understand where models are failing and build the data that fixes it

 - Build the tooling and workflows that make labeling faster and more reliable — this isn't just people management, it's systems work

What we're looking for

 - Direct experience managing a labeling, annotation, or data-quality team

 - Extremely detail-oriented — you notice when data is wrong, inconsistent, or incomplete before anyone points it out

 - Strong operational instincts — you can run many datasets, annotators, and priorities at once without dropping the details

 - Technical enough to work with ML engineers — you understand false positives, false negatives, class imbalance, and train/test splits, and you can set up your own tools to speed up labeling

 - Resourceful — when we need a new kind of data, you figure out how to find it

 - High ownership — you don't just coordinate the work, you make sure the dataset is actually good

Nice to have

 - Familiarity with labeling platforms like Labelbox, CVAT, or Supervisely

 - Basic SQL or Python for querying and cleaning data

 - Background in construction, CAD, or other visually complex technical domains

What we offer

$90,000–$125,000 base salary, plus equity. Full-time, in-person in our San Francisco Bay Area office. Standard 4-year vesting with a 1-year cliff.





Comp Philosophy 

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, M&A
jobs.description:
About Bobyard



Construction is a trillion dollar industry that still runs on manual work. Contractors measure and count materials off drawings by hand, and it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates so bids get done 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and revenue is growing quickly.



About the role



We're growing our services and data operations alongside our software, including by acquiring and integrating small services businesses. You'll be the first person in this function. You'll own what happens after we sign: bringing each company onto our software and processes, redesigning how work gets delivered, and building one operation that runs across all of them. This is a hands-on job. You'll spend real time inside the businesses we acquire, with the people who do the work. In twelve months, every company we've acquired should run on one playbook and one scorecard, and deliver faster and at better margins than when we bought it.



What you'll do



 - Build and run our post-merger integration playbook, from Day 1 through the first 100 days and beyond

 - Map, standardize, and redesign service delivery workflows, then move them onto Bobyard's software and automation

 - Lead change management with acquired teams: communication, training, retention, and adoption

 - Build and manage delivery capacity across onshore and offshore teams, including vendor selection, QA, and capacity planning

 - Design and own the operating scorecard: turnaround time, quality, margin per job, utilization, and customer retention

 - Partner with finance and leadership on operational diligence for new deals, and on tracking results against the investment plan

 - Work with each company's general manager to hit targets without losing customers or key people

 - Build the team and the processes that let us integrate the next company faster than the last



What we're looking for



 - 4+ years in operations, including hands-on post-merger integration of at least two acquired businesses

 - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field

 - Experience running service delivery with measurable throughput, quality, and cost targets

 - A track record of leading change management with teams that didn't ask for the change

 - Experience building or managing offshore or distributed delivery teams

 - Strong commercial judgment. You can read a P&L and connect operating metrics to financial returns.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, heavy travel weeks, and doing the work yourself



Nice to have



 - Operations or integration experience at a PE-backed roll-up or a tech-enabled services company

 - Experience moving manual services work onto software or automation

 - Background in construction, preconstruction, or estimating services

 - Experience running data-labeling or quality-assurance operations



What we offer



 - $140K–$160K base + equity + bonus

 - Medical, dental, and vision, and a 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%

 - A first-in-function seat with a direct line to the CEO and a clear path to leading our services business


Comp Philosophy 

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Bobyard

Construction is a trillion dollar industry running on manual work. Contractors still measure and count materials off drawings by hand — it takes forever. Bobyard uses AI to automate takeoffs and estimates, making bids 10x faster. We're Series A, backed by 8VC, Primary, and Pear, and we're shipping faster than most teams can track.

About the Role

The product team is launching new trades, features, and fixes constantly — sometimes a dozen projects in flight at once. Right now, nobody owns making sure what ships is actually fixed, actually launched, and actually communicated. That's this role. You'll sit between engineering and every customer-facing team, verify that bugs are really resolved before we tell anyone they're fixed, and make sure every launch comes with a clear, honest update to the people who need it — customers, CSMs, and sales alike.

What You'll Do

 - Own the day-to-day truth of Linear — every ticket has a real status, nothing goes stale or slips silently past its target date

 - Independently verify that "fixed" tickets are actually fixed before they're closed or communicated

 - Write and send launch communications for every release — clear, specific, no corporate filler — to customers and internal teams

 - Build and run a standard launch checklist so marketing and CS are looped in before a release, not briefed after

 - Coordinate directly with Platform engineers on active projects — you're in their tickets, not waiting on a summary

 - Flag risk and slippage early, in the same weekly rhythm the product team already runs

 - Be the first call when a customer says something's broken and an engineer says it isn't

What We're Looking For

 - 2–5 years in a role that combined technical coordination with customer-facing communication — Implementation, CS Ops, QA, or release coordination

 - Fluent in Linear or Jira — daily use, not passing familiarity

 - Can write the same update two ways: technical for engineers, plain for customers

 - Comfortable pushing back on an engineer's "it's fixed" claim without making it a fight

 - Genuinely enjoys verification and follow-through — you don't lose interest once something's "probably done"

 - Based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco

Nice to Have

 - Experience at a Series A–C startup with no dedicated QA team

 - Background in construction tech, PropTech, or a technical B2B product

 - Experience building a launch or release process from scratch

What We Offer

$120,000–$150,000 base salary, plus 0.02%–0.04% equity (4-year vest, 1-year cliff). Based in San Francisco, on-site with the team at 101 2nd Street.



Comp Philosophy 

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver.
